<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: SEO Lab - Product Suite
 * Description: Provides Product schema and a deliberately conflicting canonical.
 */
function seo_lab_product_suite_duplicate_canonical() {
    if (is_page('sample-product')) {
        echo "\n";
        echo '<link rel="canonical" href="https://example.test/legacy-product/" data-seo-spike="duplicate">';
        echo "\n";
    }
}
function seo_lab_product_suite_schema() {
    if (is_page('sample-product')) {
        echo '<script type="application/ld+json" data-seo-lab="product-schema">';
        echo wp_json_encode([
            '@context' => 'https://schema.org',
            '@type' => 'Product',
            'name' => 'Sample Product',
        ]);
        echo '</script>';
    }
}
add_action('wp_head', 'seo_lab_product_suite_duplicate_canonical', 20);
add_action('wp_head', 'seo_lab_product_suite_schema', 30);
